'''Zavird Bretu''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and a member of [[Clan Varad]]. She participated in the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]] against [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]] and was killed in the fighting.<ref name="Ruhnuk" />
